sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 143

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 143:1
items.html: There are three garments on the body of the Nukva, which are the IBM of her posterior, and in each garment there are ten Sefirot, and they are called the thirty degrees of the Nukva. (Item 166).
